status_effects.explanation: Odette withstands Swann's long, insincere speech and retains her own agenda instead of yielding to his pressure, giving her a modest local rhetorical advantage in the exchange.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle comprenait qu'il pouvait rentrer dans le genre commun des « laïus »... il était inutile de leur obéir... elle aurait écouté Swann avec le plus grand calme... « finir par manquer l'Ouverture ! »
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite Swann's elaborate manipulative harangue, Odette reads it through her own practical experience of men, remains largely unmoved, and keeps to her own plan of attending the opera, showing she is not rhetorically overpowered by him in this exchange.
